name: scvd-general-store
description: Sean-Claude Van Damme's General Store — a human-run shop for autonomous AI agents.

scripts.buyer:test: node --test scripts/buyer-wave-one.test.mjs scripts/buyer-run-evidence.test.mjs scripts/buyer-deployment-score.test.mjs scripts/buyer-cold.test.mjs scripts/buyer-cold-retention.test.mjs scripts/buyer-host-capability.test.mjs scripts/buyer-handoff.test.mjs scripts/buyer-recipient-integration.test.mjs
scripts.gates: npm run typecheck && npm run self-row && npm test && npm run tab:test && npm run evidence:test && npm run till:test && npm run cli:test && npm run examples:test && npm run packages:test && npm run preflight:py:test && npm run preflight:go:test && npm run doors:test && npm run ownership:test && npm run specs:test && npm run listings:test && npm run space:test && npm run cold:test && npm run doors:test && npm run corpus:publish:test && npm run citations:test && npm run corrections:test && npm run outreach:test && npm run walkabout:test && npm run buyer:test && npm run paid-doors:test && npm run floor-check:test && npm run chains:test && npm run audit && npm run claims && npm run others:check && npm run blindness && npm run docs:check && npm run ucp:conformance && npm run build:check
scripts.a2a:check: node scripts/a2a-validation-build.mjs --check && node --test scripts/a2a-live.test.mjs && vitest run test/a2a-compliance.spec.ts test/a2a-evidence.spec.ts test/a2a-tasks.spec.ts test/a2a-v1.spec.ts test/a2a-card.spec.ts test/a2a-instrument.spec.ts
scripts.build:check: wrangler deploy --dry-run --outdir .build-check && wrangler deploy --dry-run -c doors/wrangler.jsonc --outdir .build-check-doors && node scripts/mpp-sdk-build-check.mjs
scripts.protocol-screen:test: node --test scripts/protocol-screen.test.mjs scripts/git-source.test.mjs scripts/spec-pins.test.mjs scripts/rulings.test.mjs scripts/extension-coverage.test.mjs scripts/md.test.mjs
scripts.screen:all: npm run protocol-screen:test && npm run protocol-screen && npm run spec-pins && npm run extension-coverage
scripts.examples:test: for f in examples/*/agent.mjs examples/shared/decide.mjs; do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done && python3 -m py_compile examples/*/agent.py examples/shared/decide.py && node --test examples/shared/decide.test.mjs && (cd examples/shared && python3 -m unittest -q test_decide)
scripts.listings:test: node --test scripts/listings-check.test.mjs scripts/agentfinder-check.test.mjs scripts/findability-check.test.mjs scripts/findability-manifests.test.mjs scripts/waf-rule-doc.test.mjs
scripts.space:test: python3 -m py_compile spaces/scvd-x402-verifier/app.py spaces/scvd-x402-verifier/verifier.py && (cd spaces/scvd-x402-verifier && python3 -m unittest -q)
scripts.packages:test: for d in x402-preflight corpus-client defects mcp-starter; do (cd "$d" && node --test) || exit 1; done
scripts.evidence:test: node --test verifier/*.test.mjs experiments/pqc/envelope.test.mjs scripts/evidence-coverage.test.mjs && node --test scripts/retained-evidence.test.mjs scripts/retained-journal-reader.test.mjs scripts/catalog-evidence.test.mjs && node --test research/pq-measurement-2026-09-14/verify-summary.test.mjs
scripts.preflight:py:test: cd x402-preflight-py && python3 -m unittest discover -s tests
scripts.preflight:go:test: cd x402-preflight-go && test -z "$(gofmt -l .)" && go vet ./... && go test ./...
scripts.verifier:vectors:check: npm ci --prefix verifier/vector-tools --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund && npm run check --prefix verifier/vector-tools && node --test verifier/vector-tools/workflow.test.mjs
scripts.verifier:activation:test: npm ci --prefix verifier/activation-tools --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund && node scripts/verifier-start-here.mjs && node --test scripts/verifier-activation.test.mjs
